## Summary

The optional JSON destination mishandles a following option, breaking the advertised combination with JUnit output.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — With `["--json", "--junit", "report.xml"]`, the parser consumes `--junit` as the JSON destination and raises `ValueError("unknown option: report.xml")`. Only consume the next argument when it is a path; otherwise retain `results.json`. — Users cannot request default JSON output before a JUnit option.
